Home task: 15-20 minutes

Reading Strategy: A Look Into the Future 2050

10mo EGB | Module 3 | Future predictions, technology, society, and jobs.

Watch a real video, listen to the short support audio, read the adapted text, and answer in your notebook.

Instructions / Instrucciones

English: Open the video link, watch the video, listen to the audio, read the short text, and answer the questions in your notebook.

Español: Abre el enlace del video, mira el video, escucha el audio, lee el texto corto y responde las preguntas en tu cuaderno.

Do not worry if you do not understand every word. Focus on the big ideas: technology, transportation, energy, space, AI, jobs, and education.

Real Source / Fuente real

Main video source: A Look into the Future - Year 2050.

Open the YouTube video

Important: The video is not embedded here. Open the link and watch it on YouTube.

Fuente del módulo: English Module 3, pages 14-15: future prediction questions and the reading Things that Will Stay in the Past.

Image Support / Apoyo visual

Look: Which old objects can you see? Which future tools can you see?

Listening Support / Apoyo auditivo

Teacher read-aloud script: Listen. In the future, some objects may stay in the past. People will use phones and apps for many daily activities. Paper maps, CDs, cash, and house keys may become less common. Maybe students will use new tools for school. A good reader uses the title and key words to find the main idea.

At home: Listen one or two times. / En casa: Escucha una o dos veces.

Adapted Reading / Lectura adaptada

Life in 2050: Better or More Difficult?

By 2050, life may change in many ways. The video mentions nanotechnology, self-driving cars, fast transportation, cleaner energy, space tourism, artificial intelligence, and online education. Some changes may help society. For example, self-driving cars could reduce accidents, new energy could help the planet, and online education could help more people study. But some changes may also create problems. Artificial intelligence and robots may change many jobs. Some people may lose their old jobs, but new jobs may appear too. The important question is not only “What will change?” The important question is: “Will these changes make life better for everyone?”

Vocabulary / Vocabulario

future = futuro
Life will change in the future.
prediction = predicción
The video makes predictions about 2050.
self-driving car = carro autónomo
Self-driving cars may reduce accidents.
renewable energy = energía renovable
Ocean energy may help the planet.
artificial intelligence = inteligencia artificial
AI may change jobs.
online education = educación en línea
More students may study online.

Notebook Evidence / Evidencia en cuaderno

Write in your notebook / Escribe en tu cuaderno:

  1. Nanotechnology: What does the video say nanobots may connect to a larger virtual reality?
  2. Transportation: Write two transportation changes mentioned in the video.
  3. Energy: What natural place could provide renewable energy in the future?
  4. Artificial intelligence and jobs: According to the video, what may happen to many current jobs by 2050?
  5. Education: What does the video say about online degrees or robot teachers in the future?

Reflection / Reflexión: Write 5-7 lines in Spanish or English.

Do you think these future changes will be positive for society? Will people's lives improve or get worse? Will many people lose jobs because of technology? Explain your opinion with one example from the video.

¿Crees que estos cambios futuros serán positivos para la sociedad? ¿La vida de las personas mejorará o empeorará? ¿Muchas personas perderán sus empleos por la tecnología? Explica tu opinión con un ejemplo del video.

Pair Preparation / Preparación en parejas

Question: What future change will be good or bad for society?

Answer frame: I think ________ will be good/bad because ________.

Spanish support: Creo que ________ será bueno/malo porque ________.
